vertical.about: 9:16 short-form (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Reels). 1080×1920. Keep text out of the bottom 470 px and the right 132 px (the content area already does).

clean.name: Clean
clean.about: Soft white cards on drifting pastel light. Friendly, product-launch feel.

editorial.name: Editorial
editorial.about: Magazine feel: serif headlines, hairline card outlines, warm paper tones, one red accent. Calm, authoritative.

blueprint.name: Blueprint
blueprint.about: Engineering night: deep navy gradients, cyan outlines, condensed DIN type, mono labels. Precise, technical.

neon.name: Neon
neon.about: Night-mode product film: near-black with violet and cyan glows, glowing card edges. Energetic.

brutal.name: Brutal
brutal.about: Neo-brutalist: flat saturated color fields, thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, heavy type. Loud, playful, confident.

glass.name: Glass
glass.about: Frosted panels over saturated color fields, geometric type. Premium, consumer-tech.

terminal.name: Terminal
terminal.about: Phosphor terminal: black-green gradients, monospace everywhere, hard cuts. Hacker, raw.

text.about: Any text. style: huge | display | title | heading | body | caption | label | mono | quote. *word* = highlighter, `x` = code. On the background by default; on: "card" inside cards.

number.about: A big number that counts up on entrance (keeps prefix/suffix, thousands separators). Optional label above and sub below.

quote.about: A pull quote with big quote marks and attribution.

card.about: A content card: optional icon, kicker, title, body, footer; tone colors a top stripe. Wide, short boxes switch to a row (icon left) automatically; row: true/false forces it.

example.title: Never push to main
example.body: Every change goes through a PR with proof.

panel.about: A plain surface (group background). Put other elements on top of it.

window.about: App window chrome (traffic lights + title). body: md text, or lines: [..] as a list; dark: true for a terminal-like body.

browser.about: Browser window: url bar + page. image: screenshot path, or a skeleton page with a hero block.

phone.about: Phone mock (or a screenshot via image). bad: true marks a clipped button in red.

terminal.about: Terminal: types cmd at its time, then prints output lines on their words. cls: g (green) | y | r | d (dim) | p (prompt) | b | v.

code.about: Code panel with syntax colors; focus: [{lines: [a, b], at}] lights lines on their words while the rest dims.

example.code:
## Task
Fix the crash
## Proof
Before/after shots

bubble.about: One chat message with avatar. from: "you" or a cast key; side auto (you = right).

toast.about: A system notification banner (app icon, app name, title, body).

post.about: A social post card (author, handle, text with *highlights*).

example.author: Grok Bot
example.text: Bots can *hand off coding tasks* to Cursor.

pr.about: Pull-request card: number, title, state tag, check pills (ok / fail).

tree.about: File tree. items: lines with leading spaces for depth ("src/", "  app.ts"); hl: indexes to highlight.

list.about: Bulleted list; marker: check | x | num | dot | arrow. Items light up on their words (at) or all at once.

table.about: Compact table: cols (header strings) and rows (arrays; true / false render as ✓ / ✕).

stat.about: A stat card: label, big counted value, sub line, optional tone stripe.

progress.about: A progress bar that fills to value (0–1) at its time; label can contain {n} counting to max.

bars.about: Horizontal bar chart that grows on entrance. items: [{label, value, color?}], unit suffix.

linechart.about: A line chart that draws itself; points: numbers; labels: x-axis strings; area fill.

donut.about: A ring gauge that fills to value (0–1) with a counted percentage in the middle.

tiles.about: A field of small tiles that light up in waves: steps: [{n, at}] (cumulative counts). Scale you can see.

icon.about: An icon (check, x, bolt, eye, shield, key, bug, clock, chat, term, play, spark, user, warn, branch, pr, merge, file, folder, lock), optionally on a tinted tile.

avatar.about: A cast mascot (blinks, looks around) or the viewer ("you").

logo.about: A brand mark: mark "grok", an image (src), or a colored dot with the name.

image.about: An image file (episode media/ or kit assets/). fit: cover | contain; radius in px; frame: card shadow.

shape.about: A plain shape for structure or accents: rect | circle | ring | pill | line | blob. fill / stroke colors (tokens ok).

arrow.about: An arrow between two elements (from / to = element ids or [x, y] points). bend: curve amount; dashed; label at the middle. Draws itself.

stamp.about: A rubber-stamp verdict (APPROVED / VERIFIED / REJECTED). Pair with the "stamp" motion.

cursor.about: A mouse cursor moving along path [[at, x, y], ...] (absolute stage coords) with click ripples at clicks: [at, ...].

note.about: A sticky-note callout with a pointer triangle (side: left|right|top|bottom).

divider.about: A thin rule (horizontal by default; vertical: true).

check.about: A big check (or x with bad: true) in a circle.

glyph.about: A huge single symbol or word as graphic (→, =, +, ×, ?, 10×, vs). Accent colored by default.

source.about: Source tag for numbers and quotes (bottom-left by default: box [88, 892, 1200, 44]).

html.about: Escape hatch: raw HTML (use tokens like var(--ink), var(--surface)). Prefer real elements.

rise.about: Rises into place with a slight forward tilt and focus pull (the house entrance).

pop.about: Scales up from small with a little overshoot. Good for badges, icons, stamps.

zoom.about: Arrives from big and blurry, settles sharp. Dramatic reveals.

shrink.about: Arrives from slightly larger (camera settle feel).

mask.about: Revealed upward inside its own box (like type rising from behind a line).

flip.about: Flips down into view around its top edge.

swing.about: Swings open like a door from its left edge.

unfold.about: Unfolds vertically from its top edge.

grow.about: Grows horizontally from its left edge (bars, rules, progress).

stamp.about: Slams down from large with a small turn. Verdicts, approvals.

tilt.about: Swings in from a 3D angle (product-shot feel).

none.about: Visible from the start, no entrance.

words.about: Words spring up one after another (kinetic type).

chars.about: Characters drop in one by one.

type.about: Typewriter with a caret; cps = characters per second.

scramble.about: Characters resolve from random glyphs (decoder feel).

count.about: Counts the number in the element up from 0 (keeps prefix/suffix, thousands separators).

hl.about: Sweeps the highlighter across *marked* words inside the element.

draw.about: Draws the strokes of an SVG element (arrows, lines, outlines, charts).

cascade.about: Children enter one after another (lists, rows of chips).

beat.about: Bigger double beat for a punchline.

glow.about: Accent ring glows around the element, then fades (keep: true to hold).

lift.about: Rises a little and stays raised (selected state).

settle.about: Returns a lifted element to rest.

dim.about: Steps back (dim + soft) and stays back until "undim".

ping.about: A ripple ring expands from the element (notification, click).

underline.about: An accent bar draws under the element and stays.

strike.about: A red line strikes through the element and it fades back.

circle.about: A hand-drawn ring is drawn around the element and stays.

box.about: A dashed accent outline traces the element and stays.

tint.about: Washes the element with a color and holds (good / bad / accent).

shimmer.about: A soft sheen passes across the element every few seconds.

move.about: Moves to a new place: to: [x, y] (absolute, top-left) or by: [dx, dy]; optional s (scale), r (turn).

turn.about: Rotates by r degrees and stays.

path.about: Follows points: pts: [[dx,dy],...] relative to its place, over d seconds.

collapse.about: Squashes to a line and disappears.

full.about: One slot: the whole content area.

center.about: One centred slot of w × h.

thirds.about: Three equal columns a, b, c.

bento.about: Big main tile left + two stacked tiles right (side0, side1).

bento-top.about: Wide main tile on top + n small tiles below (b0..).

headline.about: A headline band on top (head) and a body area (body) — for scenes without a title.

ring.about: n tiles of size × size on an ellipse around the centre (n0..) + centre slot.

cascade.about: n overlapping cards stepping down-right (s0..), like a stack of windows.

row.about: n boxes of h height in a centred row (i0..).

columns-hero.about: Big statement on the left third, n stacked items on the right (k0..).

transitions.whip: both frames flung sideways with motion blur (topic jump)

archetypes.board:
board — a work board (PR tracker / kanban). Cards land in lanes, then move between lanes on their words; a sweep
line passes over the board ("every 30 minutes") and cards pick up red flags or green checks as it checks them.
data: { cols: ["Working", "Ready for review", "Merged"], colTone?: [null, "#3a6cf4", "#8b5cf6"],
        items: [{ id: "#4821", title: "Fix onboarding crash", col: 0, at?, who?: "<cast>",
                  moves?: [{ col: 1, at, flag?: "CI failing", ok?: "Checks pass" }] }],
        sweeps?: [{ at, label?: "every 30 min" }], title? }
archetypes.chat:
chat — an agent-app conversation. Sidebar of bots, a thread where each message lands on its word (bots "type" first),
tool-run rows (spinner → check), skill chips, proof thumbnails, an approval card, a summary report. The thread scrolls itself.
data: { bot: "quill", sidebar?: ["quill", "jenny"], status?: "Working · cloud computer", composer?: "Message Quill…", app?: "Grok Bot",
  messages: [ { from: "you" | "<cast key>", text?, at?, time?: "07:58", typing?: true,
                chips?: ["/react-native-best-practices"], tool?: { text: "Started Cursor cloud agent", detail?: "fix/…", icon?: "bolt", doneAt?, done?: "Agent finished" },
                shots?: [{ label: "Before", bad?: true, title? }], approval?: { title, sub?, button?: "Approve", at? },
                report?: [{ k: "PRs ready", v: "14", tone?: "good"|"bad" }] } ] }
archetypes.clock:
clock — a night (or day) on a timeline. A playhead sweeps between events; the big clock follows it.
data: { from: "21:00", to: "08:00", events: [{ time: "21:00", label: "Director picks up requests", cast?, at? }], day?: false }
archetypes.code:
code — an editor window. Lines reveal early (or type out), focus bands light the lines being discussed while the rest
dims, diff lines (+/-) get green/red gutters, and notes pin to lines from a side column with a connector.
data: { file: "handoff-brief.md", lang?: "md"|"js"|"ts"|"py"|"sh"|"yaml", code: "line\nline", tabs?: ["role.md"],
        reveal?: "lines"|"type"|"all", typeBy?: phrase|sec, focus?: [{ lines: [3, 5], at }],
        notes?: [{ line: 4, text: "Proof is required", at, tone?: "good"|"bad"|"warn" }], diff?: true, w? }
archetypes.compare:
compare — before / after proof. Two screens (mock phones or images), and a review log on the right where a bot checks
the proof: a failing check rings the problem on the "after" screen and sends it back; a later check swaps in the fixed
screen and stamps it.
data: { left: { label: "Before", phone?: { title, bad: true } | image? }, right: { label: "After", phone?: {...} | image? },
        who?: "<cast>", log?: "Proof review",
        checks: [{ text: "Button still clipped at 320pt", verdict: "fail"|"pass", at?, swap?: { phone: {...} } }],
        stamp?: { text: "VERIFIED", at? } }
archetypes.compose:
compose — a free scene assembled from the element, motion and layout libraries. This is the default way to build
a scene that doesn't match a recipe archetype: every video gets its own pictures.
data: {
  layout?: "split" | { type: "grid", cols: 3, rows: 2 },        (slots; see LAYOUTS in docs/CATALOG.md)
  els: [ { id?, el: "card", slot?: "left" | 0, box?: [x, y, w, h], x?, y?, w?, h?, z?,   (placement: slot, box, or x/y/w/h)
           ...props of the element (text, style, title, ...),
           in?: "rise@phrase" | { m, at, off, d, ...params } | "none",   (default: a fitting entrance, spread over the narration)
           do?: ["pulse@phrase", "glow@phrase+0.4", { m: "move", at: "x", to: [x, y] }],
           out?: "sink@phrase", loop?: "float" | ["float", "shimmer"],
           kids?: [...elements], layout?: ...   (el: "group" lays its kids out inside its box) } ],
  beats?: [ { at, cam: { focus: "id", z: 1.06, k: .35 } | "reset" | { x, y, z } },
            { at, focus: "id" | ["id", ...] | "all" },          (others dim back — depth of field)
            { at, do: { id: "pulse", other: "shake" } } ],
  autocam?: true    (gentle push toward each element as it enters), showSlots?: true (draw the layout's slots, for planning) }
archetypes.endcard:
endcard — the last 15–20 s: YouTube end-screen slots (place the real elements in YouTube Studio over these frames),
channel mark + subscribe, and one closing line. Use "lines": [] and "min_dur": 18 for a music-only outro.
data: { title?: "Watch next", line?: "New breakdowns every week", slots?: [{ label: "Best for you" }, { label: "Latest" }],
        channel?: "TrueSight AI", logo?: "assets/brand/logo.png" }
archetypes.flow:
flow — nodes in columns, connectors draw in, pulses travel along them. Routers, pipelines, "who talks to whom".
data: { cols: [[{ id, label, sub?, cast?, color?, at? }], ...], edges: [["a","b"], ...], pulse?: true, note?: { text, at? } }
archetypes.post:
post — a real post / quote / article as proof, with phrases highlighted as they are spoken, plus a source tag.
data: { author: "Elon Musk", handle: "@elonmusk", date: "Oct 7, 2026", avatar?: "EM", verified?: true,
        text: "Going forward ... *best back end model for any given task* ...", hlAt?: ["best back end", ...],
        side?: { title: "What it means", items: [{ text, sub?, at? }] }  |  stats?: [{ label, value, suffix?, dec?, at? }],
        source: "x.com/elonmusk/status/2107724314451878104" }
archetypes.rules:
rules — a numbered rule file. Each rule lights up when it is spoken; earlier ones stay, later ones wait dimmed.
data: { file: "house-style · SKILL.md", tag?: "SHARED BY ALL BOTS", items: [{ text, sub?, code?, at? }] }
archetypes.scorecard:
scorecard — a rubric. Round 1 fills, failing rows flag red, the worst ones go back; round 2 fills and passes.
data: { title?: "Critic scorecard", file?: "review_log.md", threshold?: 8, max?: 10,
        rows: [{ label: "Hook", sub?: "first 2 s", r1: 5, r2?: 8, issue?: "Hook is flat" }],
        r1At?, flagAt?, r2At?, side?: [{ text, sub?, at? }] }
archetypes.stepper:
stepper — a state machine. Dots along a line fill as each state is reached; a big card names the current state.
data: { steps: [{ label: "Brief", file?: "brief.md", at? }], caption?: "One look at the folder tells you where it stands" }
archetypes.swarm:
swarm — scale you can see. A big counter on the left; on the right a field of agent tiles. First only "from" tiles light
(by hand), then manager bots appear and the rest of the field lights in a wave while the counter climbs to "to".
data: { from: 15, to: 200, suffix?: "+", label: "cloud agents at once", fromLabel?: "By hand", toLabel?: "Managed by bots",
        at?: phrase (first state), toAt?: phrase (scale-up), cast?: ["quill", ...], source? }
archetypes.table:
table — a comparison grid. Column heads first, then each row lands on its word; cells are ✓ / ✕ / – or short text.
A column can be spotlighted at the end (the answer).
data: { cols: [{ title: "Grok Bot", sub?: "outer loop", cast?, tone? }], rows: [{ label, sub?, cells: [true, false, "text"], at? }],
        highlight?: { col: 0, at?, text?: "Use both" }, labelW?: 560 }
archetypes.versus:
versus — the wrong way gets struck out, the right way gets checked. Leave out "right" for a ban list.
data: { left: { title: "One prompt", tag: "DEMO", items: [{ text, sub?, at? }] },
        right?: { title: "A studio", tag: "SYSTEM", items: [{ text, sub?, at? }] },
        verdict?: { text: "Ban each cliché *by name*", at? } }
